Plain Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 12:48am

Ingredients




1/2 cup Butter
1 cup Sugar
2 Eggs
1 3/4 cups Sifted flour
1/4 teaspoon Salt
3 teaspoons Baking powder
3/4 cup Milk

Preparation

1 Cream butter and sugar. Beat eggs and stir in. Sift together flour, salt and baking powder. Add alternately with milk. Bake in a 9 x 9" pan at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes. 2 Use this recipe for strawberry shortcake.
